📢 We're Hiring: Business Analyst – Reconciliation | Alteryx
🕒 Shift Timings: Flexible – 7:30 AM–4:30 PM / 1:00 PM–10:00 PM / 2:30 PM–11:30 PM IST
We are looking for detail-oriented professionals with experience in financial reconciliation, MS Excel, and Alteryx to support financial operations. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, an understanding of financial data, and the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies accurately.
Perform cash reconciliation and ensure accuracy in financial records.
Use Alteryx for data preparation, blending, and analysis.
Work with Excel and tables for financial data management and reporting.
Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies in financial records.
Ensure compliance with applicable US and non-US regulations, including tax requirements.
Prepare reports using MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Manage multiple tasks, prioritize workloads, and meet deadlines.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve processes and controls.
Communicate effectively with stakeholders and team members.
✅ Data Analysis and Discrepancy Resolution
✅ Strong Communication and Analytical Skills
Willingness to work from the Mumbai office five days a week.
Flexibility to work in the specified shift timings.
📩 Interested candidates: Please share your updated resume to : gayathri.s1@artech.com and varshini.m@artech.com
